stories.title: 'End of days' atmosphere at Stormont as party relationships deteriorate
stories.summary: Take Stormont, throw in a looming assembly election, add fresh rows over the Irish language and the ingredients for another Christmas crisis are all there.

stories.title: Murder suspect's mother told police she tried to help but 'couldn't save the girl'
stories.summary: A court heard Mary Lynch told police she was present when her son attacked Carrie Mullane but the she did not think she had died.

stories.title: Police treating threatening email sent to more than 300 schools as 'hoax'
stories.summary: Police are conducting urgent enquiries, and liaising with schools - but the Department of Education urged schools to remain open.

stories.title: Man charged after unrest following visit from former US President Biden
stories.summary: Joe Biden was in Dublin to see his son Hunter awarded the Gold Medal for Outstanding Contribution for Public Discourse

stories.title: Troubles investigations could cost up to £630m, says legacy body chief
stories.summary: Sir Declan Morgan has told MPs the ICRIR could end up handling 650 cases once it is reformed in legislation before Parliament.

stories.title: UK falls silent to mark Armistice Day
stories.summary: Services have been held across the UK to mark Armistice Day, commemorating the end of World War One.

stories.title: NI can draw on strong club form in key window
stories.summary: Northern Ireland manager Michael O'Neill believes there are players in his squad who have the ability to become Premier League regulars.

stories.title: PSNI taking 'more robust' approach to e-bikes and scooters
stories.summary: Police say they seized 473 e-scooters and e-bikes between 1 January and 31 October 2026.

stories.title: Meet the visually-impaired actors creating pictures through sound
stories.summary: An audio drama workshop has brought blind and partially-sighted people together to create a new play.

stories.title: Cattle cull was lawful but there were operational shortcomings, review finds
stories.summary: Ireland's former chief veterinary officer Dr Martin Blake carried out a review of the operation.

stories.title: Law on 'holiday hunger' passed by Stormont assembly
stories.summary: A majority of 49 to 24 assembly members backed the legislation, which was proposed by Sinn Féin's Danny Baker and welcomed by some parents and charities.

stories.title: Jury discharged in Chloe Mitchell murder trial
stories.summary: The judge has given no reasons for the decision but said he will give his reasons in due course, after the conclusion of the trial.
